The [[Tower Golem]] is a magical creature patrolling the grounds of [[Wizard's Folly tower|the tower]] in [[Wizard's Folly]]. 

==Locations==
*[[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]]
**{{NPC location|Wizard's Folly}} (only during [[The Supremacy of Air]])

==Notes==
*The Tower Golem is weak against [[lightning damage]].
*It is not openly aggressive until you attack it.
*It [[patrol|patrols]] in a triangle near the Wizard's Folly tower.
*Although the model is similar to that of the [[Enchanted armor]], it is unique.
